## Email campaigns your whole team can build

Acme Mail Studio brings design, review and sending into one workspace, so a campaign goes from draft to inbox without a hand-off.

#### Shared drafts

Everyone edits the same draft, and every change is kept in the history.

#### Review links

Send a review link to a colleague who has no account, and collect their comments in the draft.

#### Scheduled sending

Pick the hour a campaign goes out in each time zone of your audience.
